title: lithocarpus variolosus
intro: Lithocarpus variolosus, commonly known as the Tanbark Oak, is a plant species in the beech family, Fagaceae. The Tanbark Oak is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful for treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Lithocarpus variolosus include wound healing, anti-diarrheal, and anti-bacterial effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
